cv.highSchoolThesisDescription: I wrote my high-school thesis about Using the Matrix Protocol for Video Calls (Využití protokolu Matrix pro videohovory). I have taken part in the <1>SPA (Students' Professional Activities)</1> with the thesis and have won the second place in the region round of the competition. The <3>source code</3> is hosted on GitHub and so is the <5>thesis text</5> and the <7>slides for the thesis presentation</7>. <9>The thesis presentation video</9> can be found on YouTube.
